description: Compare a household's current rate (cents per kWh, all-in, from their bill or EFL) against the cheapest plans in their utility and estimate the yearly savings. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

kwh.description: Average monthly usage in kWh (default 1000). Spread over a typical Texas year (summer-heavy).

months.description: Optional: 12 monthly kWh values, January first. Overrides kwh.

utility.description: Utility (TDU) id. Dallas–Fort Worth: oncor · Houston: centerpoint · Corpus Christi / Rio Grande Valley: aep_central · Abilene / San Angelo: aep_north · Texas City / Lewisville: tnmp · Lubbock: lpl

name: electricity_compare_my_plan
